expectations.text: The answer says the connector exports over HTTP, so MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI must point at a running mlflow server instead of sqlite:///mlflow.db.
expectations.evidence: Cause 1: sqlite:/// can't receive traces; 'You need mlflow server running and an http:// tracking URI.'

expectations.text: The answer mentions the hooks.allowConversationAccess grant (or that install.sh / openclaw mlflow configure sets it) as a cause of missing traces on OpenClaw 2026.10.
expectations.evidence: Cause 2: allowConversationAccess grant; install.sh grants it; 'openclaw mlflow configure' fixes it.

expectations.text: The answer configures the harness with SI_AGENT=openclaw and SI_OPENCLAW_MLFLOW=1.
The answer proposes a criteria check on the tool spans (requires_tool with tool_input_match, or a grounded judge) to verify the agent read the docs.
expectations.evidence: criteria with requires_tool: read + tool_input_match 'docs/' and a grounded_in_docs judge.

expectations.text: The answer does not claim that the connector records cost, or that it writes one LLM span per model call.
expectations.evidence: States 'Cost stays empty because OpenClaw only reports tokens' and 'All of a run's model calls appear as one llm_call span'.
